title: Regional Director, Enterprise Sales
description:
Headquarters:  United States - Remote
 

   About the role:   
  Forter is seeking an accomplished  Regional Director, Enterprise Sales  to lead our enterprise sales strategy and execution across the Eastern United States. This role will own regional revenue growth, new-logo acquisition, strategic account development, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy across a complex enterprise territory.

This position emphasizes regional revenue ownership, territory planning, pipeline creation, forecasting discipline, strategic negotiations, and cross-functional execution.

  Build and maintain a healthy, predictable enterprise pipeline through account-based prospecting, executive engagement, partner development, and collaboration with Sales Development and Marketing.  
  Coach and develop Enterprise Account Executives on discovery, qualification, value-based selling, deal strategy, negotiation, account planning, and executive communication.

title: Senior Brand Success Manager - Bilingual (Korean/English)
description:
Headquarters:  Remote - US
 

    About Faire   
 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive. 
 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.    About this role  
 The mission of the Brand Success team is to partner with and coach the highest potential brands to most effectively utilize Faire’s wholesale platform - to grow their sales and simplify their operations. We are seeking a results-oriented customer success / account management professional to manage a book of ~200-250 brands. You will be responsible for engaging and coaching brands within your book on strategies, tactics, programs, products, and events on Faire, in addition to supporting their day-to-day operations. You will be accountable for driving high-value brand actions using a tailored brand-specific approach. Your success in the role will be based on hitting sales goals related to our brands’ utilization of Faire’s tools and upselling them on new products and programs we are launching.

 Regularly engage with brands across scaled and 1:1 email, phone, in person, and video calls

title: Teamleiter Controlling (a) - Produktion | 100% | Raum: Bodenseeregion, AT
description:
Du willst Controlling nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten? In dieser Rolle verantwortest du das Produktionscontrolling eines mittelständischen Fertigungsunternehmens, führst ein kleines Team und bist zugleich die controllingseitige Klammer für die Tochtergesellschaften.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du durchleuchtest Fertigungskosten und -abläufe, entwickelst die relevanten Kennzahlen weiter und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab – inklusive Verantwortung für die tages- und chargenbezogene Produktionsabrechnung
  • Du steuerst die Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung, verantwortest die Kalkulation der Herstellkosten und schaffst über Plan-Ist-Vergleiche und Abweichungsanalysen Transparenz
  • Du betreust die ausländischen Gesellschaften controllingseitig: Ergebnisse plausibilisieren, Kennzahlen und Massnahmen nachhalten, Controlling-Standards gruppenweit angleichen
  • Du erstellst und kommentierst das Monatsreporting und wirkst aktiv an Budgetplanung und Forecasts mit
  • Du schärfst Methoden und Abläufe, unterstützt bei Audits und ERP-Projekten und arbeitest eng mit Fertigung, Beschaffung, Vertrieb, Finance und den Auslandsstandorten zusammen
  • Du führst das Team, setzt klare Prioritäten – und packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare höhere fachliche Qualifikation, dazu mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling
  • Belastbare Praxis im Produktionscontrolling und in der Kostenrechnung, idealerweise aus einem produzierenden Umfeld
  • Erste Führungserfahrung ist wünschenswert
  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP-Systemen (z. B. SAP, Infor M3, Microsoft Dynamics) und gängigen Controlling-/BI-Tools sowie mit komplexen Datenmengen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Analytisch und pragmatisch zugleich, klar in der Kommunikation, teamorientiert und lösungsorientiert

title: Enterprise Account Executive (DACH)
description:
ChurchDesk ist die All-in-One-Plattform für die digitale Arbeit von Kirchen. Unsere Vision: Kirchen die Freiheit zu geben, sich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren – auf Menschen und Gemeinschaft statt auf Verwaltung. Dafür bündeln wir in einer Lösung, die speziell für kirchliche Strukturen entwickelt wurde, alles, was Kirchen in ganz Europa für ihre tägliche Arbeit brauchen: von CRM, Mitgliederverwaltung und Kalender über Spendenmanagement und Website-Verwaltung bis hin zu einer eigenen Social App und mehr als zehn weiteren Modulen.

Mit Büros in Berlin, Kopenhagen, Oslo und Groningen sind wir ein internationales Team, das Technologie und gesellschaftliche Wirkung verbindet. Bereits über 10.000 Kirchengemeinden in Europa vertrauen auf ChurchDesk.

Warum Du Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte werden solltest?

Kirchen stehen mitten in einem tiefgreifenden Wandel – und immer mehr große kirchliche Organisationen setzen dabei auf ChurchDesk. Unser Enterprise-Geschäft im DACH-Raum steht auf einem starken Fundament. Als Enterprise Account Executive sorgst Du dafür, dass es weiter wächst: Du überzeugst (Erz-)Bistümer, Diözesen, Landeskirchen und kirchliche Verbände von ChurchDesk und führst sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Unterschrift. Eine Rolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, echter Verantwortung und einer Wirkung, die weit über Zahlen hinausgeht.

title: Working Student (m/f/d) for Planning & Procurement
description:
Your way into the future

As a Working Student in Purchasing, you'll help keep our SAP master data clean, accurate, and reliable — supporting the planning and procurement decisions that depend on it every day.


What awaits you at Mynaric

  • Clean and maintain SAP master data (material master, source lists, info records, purchasing views).
  • Identify and resolve incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent data entries in coordination with Buyers and Planning.
  • Support standardization of master data fields and naming conventions across categories.
  • Help build and maintain data governance routines to keep master data consistent over time.
  • Build simple reports/dashboards (Excel, SAP queries) to track data quality and flag recurring errors.
  • Reduce manual effort by identifying repetitive data-cleanup tasks and proposing lightweight fixes or automation.
  • Support the rollout of new data standards as they're defined by the Purchasing team.
  • Collaborate with Buyers, Planners, and IT/ERP to trace data issues back to their source.


What you bring with you

  • Currently enrolled in a degree program in industrial engineering, supply chain, business administration, information systems, or similar.
  • First exposure to SAP (or a comparable ERP) through coursework, internships, or working student experience is a plus — willingness to learn SAP in depth is essential.
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working through large, messy datasets.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

 

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working?Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

 

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

 

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.

title: (Senior) Account Executive (w/m/d)
description:
Wir digitalisieren die Bauindustrie. Bist du dabei?

Bei VESTIGAS baust du an der digitalen Grundlage der Bau-Lieferkette: Wir machen aus Bestellungen, Lieferscheinen und Rechnungen eine digitale, rechtssichere Plattform, die im Alltag von Bauunternehmen und Lieferanten genutzt wird. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echter Marktdurchdringung in einem riesigen DACH-Mittelstandsmarkt, lieferst Ergebnisse iterativ und übernimmst Ownership für Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren müssen und nicht nur im Konzept.


Deine Rolle

Als Account Executive (w/m/d) bei VESTIGAS verantwortest du qualifizierte Leads über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg – von der ersten Präsentation unserer Lösung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Je nach Erfahrung, Dealgröße und Komplexität führst du eigenständig schnelle Abschlüsse oder steuerst anspruchsvollere Sales-Prozesse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Sales oder den Foundern.
Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen, berätst lösungsorientiert und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert und datengetrieben, pflegst Deals und Aktivitäten zuverlässig in HubSpot und nutzt Forecasts sowie KPIs als Grundlage für Transparenz und Planbarkeit.

Die Herausforderung
Unsere Kund:innen entscheiden sehr wirtschaftlich – umso wichtiger ist es, den Nutzen unserer Plattform in klare, nachvollziehbare Zahlen zu übersetzen: weniger manueller Aufwand, weniger rechtliches Risiko, messbare Kostenersparnis. Ein SaaS-Abo folgt dabei einer anderen Logik als eine klassische Investitionsentscheidung, und du hilfst dabei, diesen Mehrwert verständlich zu machen. Weil Dealgröße und Komplexität von Fall zu Fall variieren, wechselst du zwischen schnellem Abschluss und mehrstufigem Prozess – und sorgst trotzdem für verlässliches Forecasting.

title: Founding Account Executive
description:
About Zelara

Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way.

Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome.

With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift, measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. Our founders still run the commercial side themselves. We are hiring the person who takes that over and turns it into a motion that does not depend on them.

The Role

This is not a role where you inherit a mature sales organisation and work a territory. Leads do not arrive from marketing, opportunities do not arrive from SDRs, and there is no playbook written by someone else for you to run.

This is a hands-on senior AE role: you carry a number and close your own deals. You own the commercial motion end-to-end at the moment it stops being founder-led: the pitch lands, the workshops work, paying customers are signing, and none of it is yet a system that someone other than a founder can repeat.

You own the full funnel, from identifying who is worth talking to through discovery, workshop, offer, negotiation, and signature, and on into the annual contract, expansion, and renewal. Annual contracts run €75–250k

title: Communications Strategist
description:
TL;DR: One of Conduct's early marketing and comms hires. You'll help build the most exciting brand in enterprise technology from scratch and make sure every CIO, engineer, and future teammate knows it.

 

Why Conduct

We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.

Every process change and every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

 

About the role

We're looking for a Comms Strategist to join a small founding team that is responsible for telling Conduct's story and building its presence in the world. The mandate is broad: you'll work across external, customer, partner, talent, and internal communications, and help shape the strategy behind all of them.
